description: RAG evaluation questions for the TrackFlow knowledge base (Engagement 7). Each question maps to the source_document whose chunk must appear in the top-3 retrieval (Recall@3 >= 80%). 'must_include' lists facts a faithful answer must contain; 'must_not_promise' flags business constraints the answer must never violate.
